test: worker routing isolation — Project A -> Worker A, Project B -> Worker B, no auto-reroute
note: No failover/reroute exists or was invented -- Project A's requests correctly fail (503) while its worker is down, and Project B is completely unaffected. This confirms per-project worker routing isolation, matching the architecture (each project has a fixed node_url; there is no mechanism in the current codebase that reassigns a project to a different worker).
